units.source_text: 小皇子七岁上开始读书，聪明颖悟，绝世无双。

en.t: The young prince began his studies at the age of seven, and his intelligence and quick understanding were unmatched in the world.

units.source_text: 皇上看见他过分灵敏，反而觉得担心。

en.t: When the Emperor saw how extraordinarily bright he was, he felt worried instead.

units.source_text: 他说：“现在谁也不会怨恨他了吧。

en.t: He said, “Surely no one will resent him now.

units.source_text: 他没有母亲，仅为这一点，大家也应该疼爱他。”

en.t: He has no mother, and for that reason alone everyone ought to cherish him.”

units.source_text: 皇上驾临弘徽殿的时候，常常带他同去，并且让他走进帘内。

en.t: Whenever the Emperor visited the Kokiden, he often took the boy with him and even allowed him to go inside the curtains.

units.source_text: 这小皇子长得异常可爱，即使赳赳武夫或仇人，一看见他的姿态，也不得不面露笑容。

en.t: The young prince was so exceptionally lovable that even a fierce warrior or an enemy could not help smiling at the sight of him.

units.source_text: 因此弘徽殿女御也不欲摒弃他了。

en.t: Because of this, the Kokiden Consort no longer wished to push him away.

units.source_text: 这弘徽殿女御除了大皇子以外，又生有两位皇女，但相貌都比不上小皇子的秀美。

en.t: Besides the eldest prince, this Kokiden Consort had also borne two princesses, but neither could compare with the young prince’s beauty.

units.source_text: 别的女御和更衣见了小皇子，也都不避嫌疑。

en.t: The other consorts and ladies of the wardrobe also no longer avoided seeing the young prince out of fear of suspicion.

units.source_text: 所有的人都想：这小小年纪就有那么风韵娴雅、妩媚含羞的姿态，

en.t: Everyone thought that, at such a young age, he already had such graceful elegance and such charming, shy poise,

units.source_text: 真是个非常可亲而又必须谨慎对待的游戏伴侣。

en.t: that he was truly a delightful playmate, yet one who had to be treated with great care.

units.source_text: 规定学习的种种学问，自不必说，就是琴和笛，也都精通，清音响彻云霄。

en.t: He mastered all the prescribed branches of learning as a matter of course, and he was also skilled at the koto and the flute, whose clear tones seemed to ring up into the clouds.

units.source_text: 这小皇子的多才多艺，如果一一列举起来，简直如同说谎，教人不能相信。

en.t: If one were to list all the young prince’s many talents one by one, it would sound almost like a lie and be hard for anyone to believe.
